positions.title: Freelance Marketing Manager
positions.description:
scale up is a leading management consultancy in the field of start-up scaling and advises many fast-growing companies in the DACH region.

I help to set up digital marketing processes for customer and employee acquisition. My responsibilities include marketing strategy, funnel development, media production, web design, and performance marketing.

In the process, I work closely with the founders and coaches, accompany consulting appointments at various companies on-site and gained a deep understanding of the Scaling Up Framework

positions.title: Founders Associate
positions.description:
simpleclub is an EdTech startup and Germany's most popular learning platform for school and education with over 2 million users per month.

I studied a lot with simpleclub in school and became a fan of the company and its founders, so after my Abitur I thought: "Why not apply and try to work there?"

I coordinated marketing, development and customer service, working closely with the founders. My key tasks included customer support, quality management, team restructuring, recruiting, and automation of internal processes.
